# Zeyad Deeb

> Software engineer in Brooklyn building machine learning and distributed systems, mostly in Rust, TypeScript, and Python.

- [Home](https://www.zeyaddeeb.com/): Projects, writing, and saved references.
- [About](https://www.zeyaddeeb.com/about): Background and interests.
- [Experiments](https://www.zeyaddeeb.com/experiments): Interactive projects in graphics, audio, collaboration, and reinforcement learning.
- [Story](https://www.zeyaddeeb.com/story): A programming history told through interactive interfaces.
- [Résumé](https://www.zeyaddeeb.com/resume): Engineering experience and skills.
- [Blog](https://www.zeyaddeeb.com/blog/posts): Articles and technical notes.
- [Library](https://www.zeyaddeeb.com/blog/library): Books, art, podcasts, videos, and saved links.
- [Source](https://github.com/zeyaddeeb/zeyaddeeb): The site, experiments, and infrastructure.

Use each page’s canonical URL when citing it. Articles are at /blog/posts/[slug]; library entries are at /blog/library/[slug].
